name: wordburn-video-01-airplane
description: Video 01 — "Airplane Mode Test". Data, scripts and media for one TikTok. No dependencies: node and ffmpeg only, and the Remotion install next door in ../remotion. This file exists for its `type` field — `beats.js` is ESM and is imported both by node scripts here and by webpack over there, and without it node reparses the file on every run and says so.
